mission: The wrongness lurches — a sudden sharp spike. The seal is being deliberately attacked. Veraine has moved from research to action. Evidence that she spent extended time at this facility, not just repurposing but studying.
why_now: Escalation before the midpoint — the timeline is compressing. Veraine's trace at Maetha's reveals a pilgrimage, not just logistics.
conflict: The spike in the wrongness means the situation is deteriorating faster than expected. Veraine isn't just ahead — she's actively accelerating the seal's failure.
turning_point: Desh's analysis of Veraine's time here: she sat where the Knights trained. A pilgrimage. Maetha's work is part of Veraine's intellectual lineage. She came here for understanding, not just components.
opening_hook: The wrongness spikes without warning. Ben staggers. Torin doesn't — he turns toward it.
closing_hook: The spike stabilizes at a new, higher baseline. The seal is weakening faster. And the next node on the Corridor — the one Desh flagged with the most recent energy signatures — is a settlement world. Civilians lived there. Possibly still do.
emotional_trajectory: Physical shock -> urgent assessment -> grim realization of acceleration

stakes.personal: Ben feeling the seal's failure in real time — visceral, not abstract
stakes.interpersonal: Torin's reaction to the spike vs. everyone else's — the gap widening
stakes.external: The seal is failing faster. Days have become critical.

setting: Maetha's Training Facility exterior, then departure aboard the Steady Returns
sensory_details: The wrongness spiking — like a bass note dropping below hearing into physical vibration; the flexible lattice at Maetha's location snapping briefly into chaos before stabilizing; Torin's tilted-head listening posture — attentive to something no one else wants to hear
action_beats: Ben staggers as the wrongness spikes — his hand catching the doorframe to stay upright
Sera braces against the wall with both palms as the Force destabilizes around them
Torin tilts his head toward the spike with an attentive listening posture while everyone else recoils
Desh punches the nav display to life and plots their course to the next node — a settlement world
notes: H12 planted — the wrongness lurches, seal deliberately attacked. Transition chapter from Part 2 Response toward the Midpoint. Veraine's extended time at Maetha's reveals her as more complex than a simple villain — she has an intellectual genealogy.
